summary: The Gas Utilities & Distributors standard covers organisations that distribute and market natural gas to end users through local pipe networks. Its disclosure topics are energy affordability, end-use efficiency and the integrity of gas delivery infrastructure.

questions.text: What is your average retail gas rate for (1) residential, (2) commercial, (3) industrial customers and (4) transportation services only?
questions.hint: Unit: rate (presentation currency per unit of gas) · Report the average retail rate for each of the four categories.

parts.label: Residential
parts.unit: presentation currency per unit of gas

parts.label: Commercial
parts.unit: presentation currency per unit of gas

parts.label: Industrial customers
parts.unit: presentation currency per unit of gas

parts.label: Transportation services only
parts.unit: presentation currency per unit of gas

questions.text: How many residential customer gas disconnections for non-payment did you make, and what percentage were reconnected within 30 days?
questions.hint: Unit: number; percentage · Report (1) the number of residential disconnections for non-payment and (2) the percentage reconnected within 30 days.

questions.text: How do external factors, including the economic conditions of your service territory, affect the affordability of gas for your customers?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Discuss the external factors affecting affordability and their impact on customers.

questions.text: How much customer gas saving, in MMBtu, resulted from your efficiency measures, by market?
questions.hint: Unit: million British thermal units (MMBtu) · Report MMBtu of customer gas savings from efficiency programmes, broken down by market.

questions.text: How many (1) reportable pipeline incidents, (2) corrective actions received and (3) violations of pipeline safety statutes did you have?
questions.hint: Unit: number · Report the count for each of the three items in the reporting period.

questions.text: What percentage of your distribution pipeline, by length, is (1) cast or wrought iron and (2) unprotected steel?
questions.hint: Unit: percentage by length · Report the percentage of distribution pipeline length for each material.

questions.text: What percentage of your gas (1) transmission and (2) distribution pipelines, by length, were inspected?
questions.hint: Unit: percentage by length · Report the percentage inspected separately for transmission and distribution pipelines.

questions.text: What efforts do you make to manage the integrity of gas delivery infrastructure, including risks related to safety and emissions?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe integrity management efforts and how safety and emissions risks are addressed.

questions.text: How many (1) residential, (2) commercial and (3) industrial customers do you serve?
questions.hint: Unit: number · Report the number of customers in each category.

questions.text: How much natural gas did you deliver to (1) residential, (2) commercial and (3) industrial customers, and (4) transfer to a third party?
questions.hint: Unit: million British thermal units (MMBtu) · Report MMBtu for each of the four categories.

questions.text: What is the length of your gas (1) transmission and (2) distribution pipelines, in kilometres?
questions.hint: Unit: kilometres (km) · Report pipeline length separately for transmission and distribution.
